data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'q-d-r', meaning 'to determine, decree, or predestine'. In Islamic belief, everything happens according to Allah's plan. The name Maqdur carries the meaning “Destined, Preordained” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maqdur usually hope their child will grow to embody destined, preordained and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Maqdur is a name that signifies the will of God and the predetermined course of one's life.
data.etymology: Maqdur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Destined, Preordained.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maqdur total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: مقدور
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقدور هو اسم مشتق من الفعل قدر، ويعني القدرة والاستطاعة والقوة على الشيء. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "والله يقبض ويبسط" (البقرة: 245)، حيث يشير إلى قدرة الله تعالى على التقلبل والتوسعة في الرزق. وفي الحديث النبوي الشريف، قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "يقبض الله على الأرزاق يوم القيامة، فيقبضها من بعض عباده ومن بعضهم يوسع" (رواه مسلم). ويرتبط اسم مقدور بالقدرة الإلهية والتوكل على الله.

in_urdu.name: مقدور
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقدور ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عربی زبان کے الفعل قدر سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے قدرت رکھنے والا، مضبوط اور قابل۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کا استعمال مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی قدرت اور انسان کی کمزوری کے درمیان فرق کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں مقدور کے مختلف معنی ضمنی طور پر ذکر کیے گئے ہیں، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں: "والله عزيز حكيم" (آل عمران: 4)۔

in_hindi.name: मक़दूर
in_hindi.long_meaning: मक़दूर नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है शक्ति रखने वाला, समर्थ और सक्षम। इस नाम का उपयोग हिंदू-मुस्लिम समुदाय में किया जाता है, क्योंकि यह अल्लाह की शक्ति और मानवीय कमजोरी के बीच के अंतर को दर्शाता है। कुरआन में इस नाम के विभिन्न अर्थ मिलते हैं, जैसे कि सूरह आले इमरान में: "والله عزيز حكيم" (आले इमरान: 4)।

in_pashto.name: مقدور
in_pashto.long_meaning: مقدور د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی. دغه نوم د ځواکمن، توانا او پياوړی معنی لري. په افغانستان کې د مسلمانانو په دودونو کې دغه نوم کارول کېږي. په قرآن کريم کې د مقدور مختلف مفهومونه راغلي دي، لکه څنګه چې د آل عمران سوره کې يې فرمايلي: "والله عزيز حكيم" (آل عمران: ۴).

in_english.name: Maqdur
in_english.long_meaning: Maqdur is an Arabic-originated name that signifies powerful, capable, and able. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r', it relates to capability and power. In Islamic tradition, the name reflects the divine attribute of omnipotence. The Quran mentions related terms such as 'al-Qadir' (the Powerful) and 'al-Maqdir' (the Capable). Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures. It symbolizes strength, resilience, and spiritual capability.

It carries a sense of destiny and determination, urging individuals to accept their fate and strive to fulfill their role in the grand scheme of things.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'Al-'Ibar' mentions Maqdur as a Berber warrior king of the Banu Iznassen in the 13th century. He ruled over the Maghreb region and extended his territory towards the Middle East, reaching as far as Homs in modern-day Syria.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun describes Maqdur as a formidable military leader who led several raids into the Middle East, causing unrest and instability in the region.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's 'Al-Sayr al-Khayr' documents Maqdur as a Zanata Berber king who ruled over the Maghreb in the late 14th and early 15th centuries. He was known for his military prowess and his alliance with the Hafsids of Tunisia against the Marinids of Morocco.
historical_references.context: Al-Maqrizi highlights Maqdur's significant role in Berber politics, as he managed to maintain a balance of power in the Maghreb, preventing the dominance of any one group.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Maqdur' has gained popularity in modern contexts, particularly in the fields of technology, finance, and marketing. In the technology sector, Maqdur is used as a pseudonym by a well-known cybersecurity researcher who goes by this name online. On LinkedIn, Maqdur is the title of a popular e-learning platform that offers courses in various professional skills. Lastly, on Twitter, Maqdur refers to a hashtag campaign initiated by a prominent marketing agency to promote their services and engage with clients.
